datasets.name: Multi-band high-resolution aerial image of the landslide area (Chongqing)
datasets.verbatim: The multi-band high-resolution aerial image of the landslide area is acquired by a UAV of DJI.

datasets.name: WorldView-3 satellite remote sensing data (Chongqing)
datasets.verbatim: The high-resolution satellite remote sensing data of WorldView-3, which was obtained before the landslide, is selected as the background image

datasets.name: Remote sensing image of the Pusa village landslide
datasets.verbatim: We use the remote sensing image acquired by UAV of the rescue team and the pre-disaster remote sensing image of the landslide area in our method.

methods.name: Landslide detection method based on back propagation neural networks with feature fusion
methods.summary: The method uses a multi-layer BP neural network to extract spectral features, a SIFT-based algorithm to match spatial shape features (dustpan or leaf models), and a change detection probability model based on pre- and post-landslide imagery to refine the detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the detection method is not available.
